entities.name: Henryk Dampc
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henryk Dampc was a Polish amateur boxer who won a silver medal in the light middleweight division at the 1959 European Championships. He competed at the 1960 Summer Olympics, but lost in the third bout to Willie Fisher.
